title: Tech Note: Using a Map in a Form

historical_commentary.text: The specific 4D form-object hit-detection technique this note describes has been made largely unnecessary by modern web-based UI (where HTML image maps or SVG regions handle this natively), and even within 4D, web areas embedding modern JS/HTML now make this kind of interactive map far simpler to build than in the classic client-only 4D era.
related_updates: Modern 4D web areas can embed HTML/SVG/JS-based interactive maps, making native hit-detection tricks like this one largely unnecessary today
